name: houssem-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Houssem Djeghri.

plugins.name: bridger
plugins.description: Let two Claude Code sessions message each other: named peers, file-based threads, ask/answer with full live context.

plugins.name: carry-on
plugins.description: Auto-resume Claude Code sessions after a usage-limit reset: hook-native, no daemon, no keystrokes.

plugins.name: self-review
plugins.description: Review every code change before the turn ends: fresh-context reviewer agents, a verified finding standard, honest convergence, and a measured token budget — enforced by a Stop hook.

plugins.name: build-split
plugins.description: Plan, build and review with each task on the cheapest model that can do it: Opus plans and judges, Sonnet builds what a check can verify, Haiku does narrow lookups — in parallel, each branch reviewed by self-review (required).
